name: Connecteam
description: Connecteam workforce app for deskless teams: users and custom fields, time clock (time activities, clock in and out, timesheet totals), scheduler shifts, jobs, forms and submissions, quick tasks, time off and chat messages. Connecteam API with an API key.
prerequisites: A Connecteam owner or admin on the Expert plan or higher, to create an API key.

CONNECTEAM_API_HOST.label: API address
CONNECTEAM_API_HOST.help: https://api.connecteam.com for accounts that sign in at app.connecteam.com; https://api-au.connecteam.com for Australian accounts that sign in at app-au.connecteam.com.
CONNECTEAM_API_HOST.patternMessage: Use https://api.connecteam.com or https://api-au.connecteam.com, without a path or trailing slash.

CONNECTEAM_API_KEY.label: API key
CONNECTEAM_API_KEY.help: Connecteam, Settings > API Keys > Add API key.
CONNECTEAM_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Connecteam refused the API key. Copy it again from Settings > API Keys, and check that the API address matches where you sign in (app or app-au).
verifyHints.403: Connecteam refused the request: an invalid or deleted API key, a key used on the wrong API address (global versus api-au), or a plan or hub without API access (Expert plan or higher per hub).
verifyHints.429: Connecteam's rate limit for the plan was reached (per minute and per day, per account). Wait and try again.

instructions:
## Connecteam
This connector reads and updates **Connecteam**, the app for deskless teams, through its REST API: users and their custom fields, the time clock (clocked shifts, breaks, timesheet totals, clock in and out), the job scheduler (shifts), jobs, forms and submissions, quick tasks, time off and chat messages.

**Personal data**: users carry names, phone numbers, emails and custom profile fields (birthday, address, IDs); time activities can carry GPS positions. Read only what the task needs.

**Setup (2 minutes, needs an owner or admin)**
1. In Connecteam open **Settings > API Keys** and click **Add API key**. Copy the key into `CONNECTEAM_API_KEY`; it gives access to the whole account, treat it like a password.
2. Set `CONNECTEAM_API_HOST` to `https://api.connecteam.com`, or to `https://api-au.connecteam.com` if you sign in at app-au.connecteam.com (Australian accounts).
3. API access needs the **Expert plan or higher**, per hub: Operations (time clock, scheduler, jobs, tasks), Communications (chat), HR & Skills (time off). Users, account and publishers work with any eligible hub. `connecteam_get_account` is the install check.

**Ids first**: every time clock, scheduler and task board is its own app instance. Get their ids with `connecteam_list_time_clocks`, `connecteam_list_schedulers` and `connecteam_list_task_boards` before calling the tools that need `timeClockId`, `schedulerId` or `taskBoardId`.

**Workflow**
- Account and people: `connecteam_get_account`, `connecteam_list_users` (filter by ids, names, emails, phones, status, change time), `connecteam_list_custom_fields`, `connecteam_list_custom_field_categories`, `connecteam_list_smart_groups`.
- Time clock: `connecteam_list_time_activities` (clocked shifts, manual breaks and time off per user, at most 92 days per call) and `connecteam_get_timesheet_totals` (hours per user and day with approval state). Live punching: `connecteam_clock_in`, `connecteam_clock_out`. Corrections: `connecteam_create_time_activities`, `connecteam_update_time_activities`.
- Scheduling: `connecteam_list_shifts` (time range in Unix seconds), `connecteam_get_shift`, `connecteam_list_shift_custom_fields`, `connecteam_list_user_unavailabilities`. Plan with `connecteam_create_shifts` and `connecteam_update_shifts`; set `isPublished` true and `notifyUsers` true to tell the staff.
- Jobs: `connecteam_list_jobs`, `connecteam_get_job`, `connecteam_list_job_custom_fields`, `connecteam_create_jobs`, `connecteam_update_job`.
- Forms: `connecteam_list_forms`, `connecteam_get_form` (questions), `connecteam_list_form_submissions`, `connecteam_get_form_submission`.
- Tasks: `connecteam_list_tasks`, `connecteam_list_task_labels`, `connecteam_create_task`, `connecteam_update_task` (send userIds, status and title every time; status completed closes it).
- Time off: `connecteam_list_time_off_policy_types`, `connecteam_list_time_off_balances`, `connecteam_list_time_off_requests` (approved only unless you pass `statuses`), `connecteam_create_time_off_request`, `connecteam_update_time_off_request` (approve or deny with `status`).
- Users: `connecteam_create_users`, `connecteam_update_users`, `connecteam_archive_users` (reversible: update with `isArchived` false), `connecteam_create_user_note`.
- Chat: `connecteam_list_conversations` and `connecteam_list_publishers`, then `connecteam_send_message` to a conversation or `connecteam_send_private_message` to one user, with a publisher id as `senderId`. Messages are delivered at once.

**Switched off at install**: `connecteam_delete_user`, `connecteam_delete_shift` and `connecteam_delete_task`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Reading the answers**
- Answers are `{ "requestId": "...", "data": {...}, "paging": { "offset": n } }`.
- Shift, clock and task times are **Unix timestamps in seconds** with a separate IANA `timezone`; dates in filters are `YYYY-MM-DD`. User ids are integers; shift, job, task and request ids are strings.
- Batch writes (`connecteam_create_users`, `connecteam_create_shifts`, `connecteam_create_jobs` and the updates) take a list and answer per item.

**Paging**: `limit` (default 10; the maximum is in each tool, up to 500) and `offset`. Raise `offset` by `limit` until a page returns fewer items than `limit`.

**Limits and errors**: rate limits are per account and plan (Expert 100 per minute and 10,000 per day) and answer 429. 401 or 403 means a wrong key, the wrong API address (global versus Australian) or a plan or hub without API access, 404 an unknown id, 422 a validation error (the body names the field); locked or approved timesheet days refuse time activity changes.

tools.name: connecteam_get_account
tools.description: Account of the API key: company id, name and time zone. The install check.

tools.name: connecteam_list_users
tools.description: List users (employees, managers, owners): id, name, phone, email, user type, archived flag, custom field values and smart groups. Contains personal data.

fullNames.description: Exact full names (first and last name with a space, any case).

createdAt.description: Only users created after this Unix time (seconds).

modifiedAt.description: Only users changed after this Unix time (seconds).

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the user custom fields (profile fields such as employee number, department, birthday) with id, name, type and dropdown options.

categoryIds.description: Only fields in these category ids.

customFieldTypes.description: Field types: email, date, phone, number, str, dropdown, file, directManager, birthday, link, location.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_custom_field_categories
tools.description: List the categories that group user custom fields, with id and name.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_smart_groups
tools.description: List smart groups (user groups built from rules, used to assign jobs, forms and chats) with id and name.

name.description: Only smart groups with this name.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_clocks
tools.description: List the time clocks of the account (one per time clock app or location) with id and name; the id is needed by every time activity tool.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_activities
tools.description: Clocked work per user in a date range: shifts with start and end (Unix seconds and time zone), job, notes and GPS, manual breaks and time off entries.

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 92 days after startDate).

jobIds.description: Only shifts on these job ids.

manualBreakIds.description: Only these manual break type ids.

policyTypeIds.description: Only time off of these policy type ids.

tools.name: connecteam_get_timesheet_totals
tools.description: Timesheet totals per user and day for a period: worked hours, breaks, overtime, pay, approval, submission and lock state.

groupIds.description: Only users in these group ids.

isApproved.description: true approved days only, false unapproved only.

isSubmitted.description: true submitted days only, false unsubmitted only.

isLocked.description: true locked days only, false unlocked only.

includePlanVsActual.description: true adds scheduled versus actual hours per day.

tools.name: connecteam_list_schedulers
tools.description: List the job schedulers (schedule apps) with id and name; the id is needed by every shift tool.

tools.name: connecteam_list_shifts
tools.description: Scheduled shifts in a time range: id, start and end (Unix seconds), title, job, assigned users, open spots, published flag, notes, tasks, breaks and status.

startTime.description: Range start, Unix time in seconds.

endTime.description: Range end, Unix time in seconds.

assignedUserIds.description: Only shifts of these user ids.

jobId.description: Only shifts on these job ids.

isPublished.description: true published only, false drafts only.

isRequireAdminApproval.description: true shifts needing admin approval only.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_get_shift
tools.description: One scheduled shift by id with assignments, job, notes, tasks, breaks and custom fields.

tools.name: connecteam_list_shift_custom_fields
tools.description: Custom fields defined on the shifts of a scheduler, with id, name and type, for use in shift customFields.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_user_unavailabilities
tools.description: Times a user marked as unavailable (and available) for scheduling in a range.

startTime.description: Range start, Unix time in seconds.

endTime.description: Range end, Unix time in seconds.

tools.name: connecteam_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs (clients, sites or projects that shifts and clocked time are tracked against): id, title, code, description, GPS address, assigned users or groups and sub-jobs.

instanceIds.description: Only jobs of these scheduler or time clock ids.

jobIds.description: Only these job ids (with their sub-jobs).

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_get_job
tools.description: One job by id with code, description, location, assignment, custom fields and sub-jobs.

tools.name: connecteam_list_job_custom_fields
tools.description: Custom fields defined on jobs, with id, name, type and options, for use in job customFields.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_forms
tools.description: List forms (checklists, reports, inspections) with id, name and creation date.

startDate.description: Forms created on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Forms created on or before, YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_get_form
tools.description: One form by id with its questions (id, type, title and options).

tools.name: connecteam_list_form_submissions
tools.description: Submissions of a form: submitter, time, and the answer to each question (text, choices, images and file links).

userIds.description: Only submissions by these user ids.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_get_form_submission
tools.description: One form submission with the submitter, submission time and the answer to every question.

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_boards
tools.description: List quick task boards with id and name; the id is needed by every task tool.

tools.name: connecteam_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks of a board: title, description, assignees, status, start and due time (Unix seconds), labels and sub-tasks.

userIds.description: Only tasks assigned to these user ids (group tasks included).

labelIds.description: Only tasks with these label ids.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_labels
tools.description: Labels of a task board with id, title and colour, to filter or tag tasks by label.

title.description: Only the label with this title.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_policy_types
tools.description: Time off policy types (vacation, sick and others) with id and name; needed for balances and requests.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_balances
tools.description: Time off balances of users for one policy type (days or hours left).

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_requests
tools.description: Time off requests overlapping a date range: user, policy type, dates or times, all-day flag, status and notes. Default status filter is approved.

startDate.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD; requests overlapping the range are returned.

endDate.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD; at most 365 days after startDate.

statuses.description: approved, pending, denied. Default approved only.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_conversations
tools.description: Chat conversations (channels and groups) the API can post to, with id, title and type.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_list_publishers
tools.description: Custom publishers (named senders for API messages) with id and name; a publisher id is the senderId of the chat tools.

offset.description: Results to skip: the previous offset plus limit (default 0).

tools.name: connecteam_create_users
tools.description: Create one or more users. Each needs firstName, lastName, phoneNumber and userType.

users.description: Users, e.g. [{"firstName":"Ana","lastName":"Diaz","phoneNumber":"+15555550123","userType":"user","email":"ana@example.com","customFields":[{"customFieldId":123,"value":"E-42"}]}]. userType is user, manager or owner.

sendActivation.description: true sends the activation SMS to the new users.

tools.name: connecteam_update_users
tools.description: Update one or more users by userId (or by phone with editUsersByPhone): name, phone, email, user type, custom field values, archived flag. Only the fields sent change.

editUsersByPhone.description: true matches users by phoneNumber instead of userId.

tools.name: connecteam_archive_users
tools.description: Archive users: they lose access but keep their history and can be restored (update with isArchived false).

tools.name: connecteam_delete_user
tools.description: Permanently delete a user and their data. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

tools.name: connecteam_create_user_note
tools.description: Add a note (title and text) to a user's profile in Connecteam, e.g. a manager remark.

tools.name: connecteam_create_shifts
tools.description: Create shifts in a scheduler. Each needs startTime and endTime (Unix seconds); assign users or make it open, set title, job, notes, tasks and breaks; publish to show it.

shifts.description: Shifts, e.g. [{"startTime":1767258000,"endTime":1767286800,"timezone":"America/New_York","title":"Morning","jobId":"...","assignedUserIds":[9170357],"isPublished":true,"notes":[{"html":"Bring keys"}]}]. Open shift: isOpenShift true with openSpots.

notifyUsers.description: true notifies assigned users of published shifts.

tools.name: connecteam_update_shifts
tools.description: Update shifts by shiftId: times, title, job, assignees, publish state, notes, tasks or breaks. Only the fields sent change.

notifyUsers.description: true notifies assigned users of published shifts.

tools.name: connecteam_delete_shift
tools.description: Delete a scheduled shift. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

tools.name: connecteam_clock_in
tools.description: Clock a user in on a time clock now (or at timestamp), optionally on a job or a scheduled shift.

jobId.description: Job id, when the clock tracks jobs.

schedulerShiftId.description: Scheduled shift id to clock in to.

timestamp.description: Clock-in time, Unix seconds; omit for now.

tools.name: connecteam_clock_out
tools.description: Clock a user out of the running shift on a time clock now (or at timestamp).

timestamp.description: Clock-out time, Unix seconds; omit for now.

tools.name: connecteam_create_time_activities
tools.description: Add past clocked shifts or manual breaks for users (e.g. a forgotten clock-in). Locked or approved days are refused.

isSplitShiftOnManualBreak.description: true splits an existing completed shift around a new manual break.

tools.name: connecteam_update_time_activities
tools.description: Correct clocked shifts or manual breaks by their id (start, end, job, notes). Locked or approved days are refused.

timeActivities.description: Per user, with the ids of the shifts to change, e.g. [{"userId":9170357,"shifts":[{"id":"...","end":{"timestamp":1704139200,"timezone":"America/New_York"}}]}].

tools.name: connecteam_create_jobs
tools.description: Create jobs (or sub-jobs with parentId) and attach them to schedulers or time clocks.

jobs.description: Jobs, e.g. [{"title":"Main St site","code":"MS-01","instanceIds":[12345],"gps":{"address":"1 Main St, Springfield"},"assign":{"type":"users","userIds":[9170357]}}]. Sub-job: {"title":"Floor 2","parentId":"..."}.

tools.name: connecteam_update_job
tools.description: Update a job: title, code, description, location, assignment, custom fields or the schedulers and time clocks it belongs to. title is required by the API.

fields.description: Job fields, e.g. {"title":"Main St site","code":"MS-01","description":"Night access via gate B"}. For a sub-job include parentId and useParentData.

tools.name: connecteam_create_task
tools.description: Create a task on a board and assign it to users; publish it to notify them.

tools.name: connecteam_update_task
tools.description: Update a task, e.g. mark it completed. The API replaces the task: send userIds, status and title every time.

tools.name: connecteam_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task from a board. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

tools.name: connecteam_create_time_off_request
tools.description: Create a time off request for a user, pending for approval or already approved.

startTime.description: Start time for a partial day, HH:MM.

endTime.description: End time for a partial day, HH:MM.

timeClockId.description: Time clock id the time off is recorded on.

isAdjustForDayLightSaving.description: true adjusts hours across a daylight saving change.

tools.name: connecteam_update_time_off_request
tools.description: Approve or deny a time off request (status), or change its dates and notes. Only the fields sent change.

startTime.description: Start time for a partial day, HH:MM.

endTime.description: End time for a partial day, HH:MM.

timeClockId.description: Time clock id the time off is recorded on.

isAdjustForDayLightSaving.description: true adjusts hours across a daylight saving change.

tools.name: connecteam_send_message
tools.description: Post a message to a chat conversation (channel or group) as a custom publisher.

tools.name: connecteam_send_private_message
tools.description: Send a private chat message to one user as a custom publisher.
